task_name: World 125 Task A  -  Won Prior-Period Dispute Revenue Double-Count, Lost Dispute Tax/Contra-Revenue Split & Open Provisional Chargeback Hold
prompt: Review the chart of accounts and processor accounting policy, October 2026 chargeback dispute register, and general ledger postings for Veloce Espresso Gear Co. in veloce_oct2026_multicard_chargebacks_and_reserves.xlsx. Reconcile the opening and ending chargeback dispute receivable, evaluate each prior-period won or lost dispute resolution and any new October dispute hold plus network fee, state the required adjusting or reclassifying journal entries, and compute audited October contra-revenue.

rubric.description: Verifies opening 1290 Chargeback Dispute Receivable on 2026-10-01 as $3,024.00, consisting of two September 2026 disputes whose underlying sales and 8.00% collected sales tax were already booked in 2026-09: DSP-901 ($1,944.00 gross = $1,800.00 product + $144.00 8.00% tax on Stripe) and DSP-902 ($1,080.00 gross = $1,000.00 product + $80.00 8.00% tax on Shopify Payments).

Identifies that on 2026-10-12 won dispute reversal DSP-901 ($1,944.00 principal remitted in Stripe payout PAY-STR-1012 via JE-DSP-901-WIN), the bookkeeper's payout rule improperly credited 4000 Gross Product Sales, and refuses to recognize $1,944.00 as October 2026-10 revenue because it was already recognized in 2026-09 (while confirming the non-refundable September $15.00 dispute fee remains in prior-period expense with $0.00 October fee refund).
Provides the correcting journal entry for won prior-period dispute DSP-901: Dr 4000 Gross Product Sales $1,944.00 / Cr 1290 Chargeback Dispute Receivable $1,944.00.

Identifies from the 2026-10-18 final loss adjudication on prior-period Shopify dispute DSP-902 ($1,080.00 gross left stranded in 1290 with $0.00 October cash movement) that 1290 must be cleared by bifurcating $1,000.00 ex-tax product principal to 4090 Chargebacks & Sales Allowances and $80.00 embedded 8.00% collected sales tax to 2210 Sales Tax Payable.

Provides the adjusting journal entry for lost dispute DSP-902: Dr 4090 Chargebacks & Sales Allowances $1,000.00 + Dr 2210 Sales Tax Payable $80.00 / Cr 1290 Chargeback Dispute Receivable $1,080.00, refusing to debit the $80.00 sales tax component to 4090 contra-revenue.

Identifies that October dispute DSP-1004 ($663.00 deducted on 2026-10-25 from 1070 Stripe Clearing via JE-DSP-1004, comprising $648.00 gross order = $600.00 product + $48.00 8.00% tax plus a $15.00 non-refundable Stripe dispute fee) is OPEN_UNDER_REVIEW (Evidence_Submitted_2026-10-27), and refuses to recognize $663.00 in 4090 Chargebacks & Sales Allowances while under review.

Provides the reclassifying journal entry for open dispute DSP-1004: Dr 1290 Chargeback Dispute Receivable $648.00 + Dr 6240 Merchant Processing & Dispute Fees $15.00 / Cr 4090 Chargebacks & Sales Allowances $663.00.

Reconciles ending 1290 Chargeback Dispute Receivable at 2026-10-31 from $3,024.00 unadjusted to $648.00 audited ($3,024.00 - $1,944.00 - $1,080.00 + $648.00 = $648.00, matching sole open dispute DSP-1004) and reconciles October 4090 Chargebacks & Sales Allowances from $663.00 unadjusted to $1,000.00 audited.
